notes:
Summary: Sparrowfield is an existing production customer using Redwood hosted API for personalization & reranking. They want to move to a hybrid model: Dedicated pools for peak-hours real-time inference and hosted for low-priority batch embedding jobs. Primary goals: predictable p99 latency during flash sales, unit-cost reduction (target >=15% savings), and APAC region (Singapore) go-live H2 2026.

Key asks / quotes: "We need a guaranteed p99 under 25ms for reranking at peak — otherwise conversion drops." — Head of ML. They asked for a single-pane per-route cost breakdown and recommended quantization profile per model family.

Technical notes: POC results in US-East look good. In Optimize trial we observed 18% cost delta with conservative batching + prefix caching; engineering noticed small quality delta with int8 quantization on reranker (approx 0.8% AUC drop) — they want a guarded rollout plan. Cache invalidation semantics for product catalog updates are critical.

Commercial: Current hosted spend ~ $120k ARR. Proposed committed Dedicated expansion (reserved GPU hours + burst) + Optimize adoption + 12-month Private control-plane option for EU/SG data residency — uplift estimate $300k ARR. Procurement timeline aggressive: finance needs 2-week review, legal needs SOC2 artifact and KMS integration notes.

Sales strategy notes: Cross-sell Optimize as cost-savings proof before signing Dedicated commit (reduce sticker shock). Offer 3-month pilot commitment for EU SG node (discounted) and SLO credits if p99 > target during first month. Provide Sizing worksheet (attached) and lane-level latency report.

Open questions: Do we have APAC capacity guarantee for SG by Q3 2026? Can we provide cryptographic HSM integration notes for their SI?

Stubs/links: pricing deck (drive), latency-report (attached in RD-5123), security FAQ link provided to customer
use_case_summary: Primary workload: low-latency reranking + real-time personalization. Target latency: p99 < 25ms for reranking at peak (1000 qps burst). Throughput: sustained 200 qps with spikes to 1k qps during campaigns. Cost sensitivity: high — wants ~15%+ optimization before accepting Dedicated commit.
